'''Ahalas Svindren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] scholar from [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] who became a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A charismatic debater and legal expert with a notably compelling voice, Svindren became a prominent Republic [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandist]]. His broadcasts were tightbeamed into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], and Svindren delivered accounts of atrocities committed by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], while using his legal expertise and debating skills to make point-by-point rebuttals of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] arguments for secession.<ref name="EGTWAC" />
